description: Ministry of Higher Education - Appoint Competent Authority to the Institute of Technology, University of Moratuwa
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (A. Ibathul Rauff Hakeem) with his ministerial title and outlines detailed responsibilities (exercising powers under the Universities Act, appointing a Competent Authority for the Institute of Technology). It contains both the "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
